faq.q: Where are Salty Dog Tags engraved?
faq.a: In Lehi, Utah, by a family with seven English bulldogs and one laser engraver. Every tag is engraved here, photographed for you before it ships, and mailed USPS.

faq.q: How fast will my tag get to me in Utah?
faq.a: We engrave and ship within 1 to 2 business days of payment, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. Wasatch Front addresses are a short trip from Lehi. Every tag is photographed before it goes out, so you'll know it's on the way.
Yes, anywhere in the US. Shipping is $4.50 and free on orders over $35. Utah sales tax is added to Utah orders.

faq.q: Is a Salty Dog Tag a Utah dog license?
faq.a: No. It's an ID tag with your phone number, not a license or rabies tag. Your city or county issues those. Our guide to Utah dog license and tag rules walks through Lehi and Salt Lake County.

faq.q: Can I write my own Utah saying?
faq.a: Yes, and please do. You get up to three lines on the front, 24 characters each, and the preview shows exactly what fits. The name and number go on the back. If a line runs long, we'll email before we engrave.
